items.t: Ocugen Eyes 2027 Trial Results and FDA Filing for Lead Gene Therapy
items.sum: Ocugen (NASDAQ:OCGN) expects pivotal data for its lead experimental gene therapy for retinitis pigmentosa in the first quarter of 2027, a milestone that could set up a regulatory filing later that year, CEO Shankar Musunuri said at a company presentation.
